author: Patrick Xjr
text:
Good afternoon 
It seems that there is a concern:
First let’s have a look on falling.
Falling is due to adhesion on skin:
The skin has to be very clean
First wash with a neutral soap, then rince and dry.
Then apply alcohol at 70% in order to be sure it is dry.
Don’t touch anymore the skin.
Apply the sensor, wait for 20 seconds before taking off the applicator. It is the necessarily time for adhesive in order to get adhesion on skin.
Adhesive tape hates oily or wet or dirty location..
Maybe you have a natural oily skin, so check the possibility to add an another adhesive over the sensor ( some are sold on internet).
For the low value in front of blood measure, the non adhesion is may be the cause. However don’t forget that the measure on skin is made on interstitial fluid and not on blood, so the measure on sensor is late for about 15 or 20 minutes to get nearly same values.
Where is located your sensor?
What kind of diabetic 1 or 2?
